network_status.network: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
network_status.summary_it: Il record identifica soltanto il territorio di Massafra e non uno specifico ponte o corso d'acqua; le fonti descrivono l'evento alluvionale dell'8 ottobre 2005 senza risolvere l'attraversamento. ARCUS non trasferisce al caso valori relativi ad altri ponti o gravine della stessa area.
network_status.summary_en: The record identifies only the Massafra municipal area rather than a specific bridge or watercourse, and the sources describe the 8 October 2005 flood without resolving the crossing. ARCUS does not transfer values from other bridges or ravines in the area.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
